description.en: Unloads a map previously loaded with CMND_CREATE_MAP.
Handle of the map to unload.
True once the call has taken effect; null if the call was invalid (e.g. too few arguments, or required engine/script state not ready).

example.code:
// Unload the debug map after the skill-test scene ends
CMND_DELETE_MAP(dbg_hMap);
